about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Full-stack PM × designer's eye
about.status: Open to AI PM / Product roles · 2026 Cohort
about.bio1: I'm 25, based in Hohhot, open to relocation. UQ MSc Interaction Design under the School of Computer Science (Group of Eight, QS Top 50), Nankai BA Marketing — a deliberately T-shaped path through the technical, design, and business sides of shipping product.
about.bio2: What I actually do well: take a product from 0 to 1, solo. The chemical-trade sales dashboard you'll see below is the cleanest proof — a 7-day sprint from user research → architecture → React/Node/PostgreSQL full-stack → live in production. I define the spec, write the code, talk to the users. That's the loop I'm best at.
about.bio3: Today I live at the frontier of AI tooling — daily-driving Claude Code, Cursor, Antigravity, and OpenClaw (self-configured with 104 Skills across 7 domains). I benchmark Claude / GPT / Gemini / MiniMax / DeepSeek into real production decisions, and I've watched the AI product arc go from chat → coding → agent → ecosystem firsthand. My belief: the best AI PMs are also AI builders.

projects.title: Featured Projects
projects.subtitle: 0→1 product builds · HCI capstones · AI infrastructure

items.title: Smart Library Thermal-Perception System
items.description: UQ DECO7285 capstone, team lead of 6, HD 7/7 (max grade). React + ESP32 sensor mesh + cloud backend. Key product call: after Contextual Inquiry revealed the library couldn't change room temperature, I redefined the button from a 'control tool' into a 'perception recorder' — flipping the entire product narrative.

items.title: Memory Future Simulator
items.description: UQ DECO3801/7381, 12 weeks, team lead of 6, Distinction 6/7. React + Vite + Tailwind. Pivoted the brief from a 'static educational tool' into a multiplayer collaborative narrative simulator — scan to join the same virtual world, vote together, watch your decisions reshape society in real time. 3 Sprints in Jira, 2 rounds Think-Aloud testing, shown at the UQ campus exhibition.

items.title: OpenClaw · Three-Tier Agent Stack
items.description: My personal AI ops, daily-driven: 104 self-configured OpenClaw Skills across 7 domains (data, social monitoring, automation, etc.), with Nova as a Minimax-powered secretary triaging tasks, HealthBot running my training plan, and Claude Code handling strategy + code. The clearest proof of moving from AI 'tool user' to 'tool-chain builder'.

items.title: Frontier-Model Benchmark Dashboard
items.description: Hands-on comparison of Claude / ChatGPT / Gemini / DeepSeek / GLM / MiniMax across coding, Chinese reasoning, agent orchestration, long context, multimodal, and cost-per-task. Not a leaderboard — one real usage story per model, mapped back to actual product decisions I've made. Public Notion dashboard.

items.title: Digital Sales Map · Chemical Sales Platform
items.description: 7-day solo end-to-end build for a chemical-trading client — research → React/Node full-stack → Aliyun ECS deployment. A Vibe-Coding practice: PM-owned business understanding + spec + QC, AI accelerated the code. National map drill-down, customer CRM, Excel batch import. Live and in pilot use.

items.title: XPENG · Tianjin Airport Store Douyin Matrix
items.description: Lead-gen content strategy for XPENG North China Zone 2. Solo script + shoot + edit. +13,000 precision followers in 2 months for the Tianjin Airport showroom. Concurrent with brand-IP playbooks I co-ran: 'Pengyou Club', 'Sunset Café', 'Weekend Arts' — all aimed at upper-funnel lead generation.

items.title: Indie AI Builder · Personal Practice
items.description: Daily-driving Claude Code / Cursor / Antigravity / OpenClaw (104 Skills) / Loveable / Stitch / Google AI Studio. Building production multi-agent systems, benchmarking frontier models, and witnessing the AI product arc go from chat → coding → agent → ecosystem firsthand.

items.title: MSc Interaction Design · School of Computer Science
items.description: QS Top 50, Group of Eight. Core: web full-stack (React / Django), physical computing, HCI. Two team-lead capstones delivered as Distinction-grade products: HD 7/7 (Smart Library) and D 6/7 (Memory Future Simulator), both publicly exhibited at the UQ campus showcase.

items.title: Regional Marketing Lead · North China Zone 2
items.description: Tianjin-based, covering Tianjin / Shandong / Hebei / Liaoning. Built the Tianjin Airport showroom's Douyin matrix solo — +13,000 precision followers in 2 months. Co-led core brand IPs ('Pengyou Club', 'Sunset Café', 'Weekend Arts'). Lead contact for Tianjin Auto Show (A-tier) and Shenyang Auto Show (B-tier). Monthly cadence: ~4 sales-promo + 4 customer-retention + 1 cross-industry event.

items.title: BA Marketing

University scholarship, Honour student, Class learning officer, founding president of the 'Mirror' campus photography society. Concurrent internships at Vans-co Studio (videographer) and Hui'en Trading (sales / market research).
